````text
# #4218: Patch: a Luau host for the C module, tested under Lune
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of #2898. `crates/wasm/c` (#3093) is the engine's C boundary for a host that isn't JavaScript, and #2898's port translates it to Luau. This issue adds the Luau side of that boundary, so the work can be checked in this repository.

## What to add

- **A top-level `luau/` folder:**
  - A `README.md` as its contract: what the folder holds, and how to install its tools and run its tests. Each crate's README plays the same role.
  - A `rokit.toml` pinning `lune-org/lune@0.11.1`, `JohnnyMorganz/StyLua@2.6.0` and `Kampfkarren/selene@0.32.0`, plus the folder's `stylua.toml` and `selene.toml`. Use Selene's `luau` standard library and declare Lune's `require("@lune/…")`.
- **`luau/src/Host.luau`:** follows `crates/wasm/c/README.md` exactly.
  - `Host.new(instance)` takes `{ exports, memory: () -> buffer }` and calls `init()` once. `init` returns nothing.
  - `host:call(name, ...)` takes strings and numbers. Each string goes in as `(ptr, len)` through `jackioh_alloc`, written with `buffer.writestring`. An empty string is `(0, 0)` with no buffer.
  - The answer is copied out of `jackioh_result_ptr`/`jackioh_result_len` before the argument buffers are freed. An empty result reads as `""`, without touching the pointer.
  - Status 1 raises `<name> refused: <message>`.
  - **A trap** (an error raised inside the call) marks the instance dead, and every later call refuses, telling the caller to open a fresh one. The result buffer counts as panic text only when it starts with `panicked at `. A trap that isn't a panic leaves the previous answer there, so say there is no text instead.
  - **Never cache the buffer** across calls: `memory.grow` can replace it.
  - **JSON stays opaque text.** Host decodes nothing. `Host.splitState(answer)` cuts the `state` member out of a `{"state":…,…}` answer (`begin_game`, `reduce`, `fold`) as its exact text. Never decode and re-encode a state: a re-encode can change it (an encoder that writes `{}` as `[]`), and the module caches states by their exact text.
  - `instance` is an adapter over whatever the translator produces. That adapter comes with the translation, in a later issue.
- **`luau/tests/host.spec.luau`:** a mock module in Luau over a real `buffer`. It implements `jackioh_alloc`/`jackioh_free` (tracking live allocations, raising on a bad free), `jackioh_result_ptr`/`jackioh_result_len`, `init`, and a few fake bindings: an echo, a two-string concat, one taking a number, a refusal, a panic trap and a trap with no panic text. It can also replace its buffer on a "grow". Cover:
  - `init` called exactly once;
  - ASCII and multi-byte UTF-8 round trips;
  - empty strings and empty results;
  - several string arguments in order, and number arguments;
  - no live allocation after any call;
  - status 1;
  - both kinds of trap, and refusal afterwards;
  - the buffer replaced mid-run, inside `jackioh_alloc`, inside a binding and between calls;
  - `splitState` on an answer whose state holds nested braces and escaped quotes.

  Use a tiny assert helper, not a framework, and exit non-zero on a failure (`@lune/process`).

## Out of scope

The translation to Luau, a CI job for `luau/` (a person adds it: workflows are outside the bot's paths), and any engine change.

## Done when

- `lune run luau/tests/host.spec.luau` passes.
- `stylua --check luau` and `selene luau` are clean.
- Each test fails when the code it covers is broken: say in the pull request which breakages you tried.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44358640527)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Add a top-level `luau/` folder holding the Luau side of the engine's C boundary. `luau/src/Host.luau` implements `crates/wasm/c/README.md` exactly: `Host.new` calls `init()` once, `host:call` marshals strings as `(ptr, len)` pairs through `jackioh_alloc` (empty string as `(0, 0)`, no buffer), copies the answer out of `jackioh_result_ptr`/`jackioh_result_len` before freeing argument buffers, raises `<name> refused: <message>` on status 1, marks the instance dead on a trap (later calls refuse), detects panic text only under the `panicked at ` prefix, re-fetches `memory()` for every access, and `Host.splitState` cuts `state` out of an answer as exact text, never decoded. Ship with it the tool pins, style/lint configs, a buffer-backed mock, a framework-free spec, and a `README.md` contract.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes there |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `luau/README.md` | new | Contract: folder layout, tool table, `cd luau && rokit install`, the three test commands, pointer to `crates/wasm/c/README.md` |
| `luau/rokit.toml` | new | `[tools]` pins: `lune`, `stylua`, `selene` (exact values in step 2) |
| `luau/stylua.toml` | new | `column_width`, `line_endings`, `indent_type`, `indent_width`, `quote_style` (exact values in step 2) |
| `luau/selene.toml` | new | Single line `std = "luau"` |
| `luau/src/Host.luau` | new | Types `CInstance`, `Host`; consts `STATUS_OK`, `STATUS_FAILED`, `PANIC_PREFIX`; locals `readResult`, `skipSpace`, `scanString`, `scanValue`; `Host.new`, `Host:call`, `Host.splitState`; ends with `return Host` |
| `luau/tests/mock.luau` | new | Type `Mock`; `Mock.new`, `Mock:grow`, `Mock:ensure`, `Mock:setAnswer`, `Mock:maybeGrow`, `Mock:count`, `Mock:liveCount`, `Mock:instance`; `exports` fields `init`, `jackioh_alloc`, `jackioh_free`, `jackioh_result_ptr`, `jackioh_result_len`, `echo`, `concat`, `addone`, `ping`, `empty`, `refuse`, `panic`, `silent`; counters `initCalls`, `allocCalls`, `ptrCalls`, `bindingCalls`; flags `growOnAlloc`, `growOnCall` |
| `luau/tests/host.spec.luau` | new | `check` and `fresh` helpers plus one named check per behavior in Tests; `require("@lune/process")`, `require("../src/Host")`, `require("./mock")`; exit 1 on failure |

Touch nothing else: no `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/`, `apps/`, `e2e/` or `spec/` edits, no engine change, no CI job. No `spec/` gameplay section and no ruling govern this change; add none.

## Steps

1. Read `crates/wasm/c/README.md` end to end (The memory interface, The calling convention, Errors and traps) and `docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` §10.5. The plan below already encodes them; this step is a fidelity check.
2. Write the three configs exactly. `luau/rokit.toml`:
   ```toml
   [tools]
   lune = "lune-org/lune@0.11.1"
   stylua = "JohnnyMorganz/StyLua@2.6.0"
   selene = "Kampfkarren/selene@0.32.0"
   ```
   `luau/stylua.toml`: `column_width = 120`, `line_endings = "Unix"`, `indent_type = "Tabs"`, `indent_width = 4`, `quote_style = "AutoPreferDouble"`. `luau/selene.toml`: `std = "luau"` (verified: this keeps `require("@lune/process")` and every `buffer.*` call below clean on selene 0.32.0).
3. Write `luau/README.md`: a table of what each file holds, the tools table with the three pinned versions, install (`cd luau && rokit install`, with Rokit on `PATH`), and from the repo root `lune run luau/tests/host.spec.luau`, `stylua --check luau`, `selene luau`. Note the adapter for `instance` arrives with the translation (a later issue).
4. Write `luau/src/Host.luau` with `--!strict` on line 1. Types: `CInstance = { exports: { [string]: any }, memory: () -> buffer }`, instance rows `{ _instance: CInstance, _dead: boolean }`. Constants: `STATUS_OK = 0`, `STATUS_FAILED = 1`, `PANIC_PREFIX = "panicked at "`. Variadic args use `...: any` plus runtime `type()` checks (not a union annotation).
5. In the same file add `local readResult(instance)`: call `jackioh_result_len()`; if 0 return `""` without calling `jackioh_result_ptr()`; else `buffer.readstring(instance.memory(), ptr, len)`. Fresh `memory()` on every call: never store the buffer.
6. Add `Host.new(instance)`: call `instance.exports.init()` once, then `setmetatable({ _instance = instance, _dead = false }, Host)`; `Host.__index = Host` at the top.
7. Add `Host:call(name, ...: any)`: if `self._dead`, `error(name .. " refused: instance is dead; open a fresh one", 0)`. Look up `exports[name]`; if nil, `error(name .. " refused: unknown binding", 0)` without marking dead. Marshal each arg: string of length 0 appends `0, 0` with no alloc; else `ptr = exports.jackioh_alloc(#arg)`, `buffer.writestring(self._instance.memory(), ptr, arg)`, append `ptr, #arg`, remember `{ptr, #arg}`; number appends as-is; anything else raises `<name> refused: argument <i> is not a string or number` before any alloc. Call `local ok, status = pcall(binding, table.unpack(parts))`. On `not ok`: free every remembered buffer, set `_dead = true`, read the result, raise `<name> trapped: <text>` where `<text>` is the result only if it starts with `PANIC_PREFIX`, else the literal `no text`. On `ok`: read the result first, then free every buffer, then if `status == STATUS_FAILED` raise `<name> refused: <answer>`, else return the answer. Free on all three paths so the mock's live-set is empty after every call (decision: the later translation issue owns real post-trap semantics).
8. Add the scanner. `skipSpace` skips `" "`, `"\t"`, `"\n"`, `"\r"`. `scanString(s, pos)` (`s[pos] == '"'`): skip `\X` pairs, return the closing quote's index or `error("splitState: unterminated string", 0)`. `scanValue(s, pos)`: skip space; `"` delegates to `scanString`; `{` walks `key : value` members with `scanString`/`scanValue` recursion returning at `}`; `[` walks elements returning at `]`; anything else runs to the next `[}%]]` via `string.find`. `Host.splitState(answer)`: require a top-level `{`, iterate members comparing the raw key text to `"state"`, return `string.sub(answer, valueStart, valueEnd)` for it, else `error("splitState: no state member", 0)`; structural failures raise `splitState: bad JSON`, a non-object raises `splitState: answer is not an object`. All `error` calls use level `0` so messages are exact.
9. Write `luau/tests/mock.luau` (`--!strict`, `return Mock`). `Mock.new()` builds one `buffer.create(64)`, bump offset `_next = 1` (0 stays invalid), `_live = {}`, `_resultPtr/_resultLen = 0`, counters zero, both grow flags false, and the `exports` table. `init` counts. `jackioh_alloc(len)` counts `allocCalls`, consumes `growOnAlloc` first, `ensure`s capacity, hands out `_next`, advances by `max(len, 1)`, records `_live[ptr] = len`. `jackioh_free(ptr, len)`: `ptr == 0` returns; else raise `bad free: <ptr>/<len>` (level 0) unless `_live[ptr] == len`, then clear. `jackioh_result_ptr` counts `ptrCalls`; `jackioh_result_len` returns the length. `setAnswer(text)`: empty sets `0, 0`; else bump-allocates, `buffer.writestring`s, records ptr/len. `grow()` doubles via `buffer.create` + `buffer.copy(new, 0, old, 0, buffer.len(old))`; `ensure(need)` grows until `len >= need`. Bindings count into `bindingCalls`, call `maybeGrow()` (consumes `growOnCall`) where they read, and read `self._buf` fresh: `echo(ptr,len)` answers its string; `concat(aPtr,aLen,bPtr,bLen)` answers `a .. b`; `addone(n)` answers `tostring(n + 1)`; `ping()` answers `"pong"`; `empty()` sets `""` and returns 0; `refuse()` sets `"nope: bad deck"` and returns 1; `panic()` sets `"panicked at 'boom', src/lib.rs:1:1"` then `error("unreachable", 0)`; `silent()` just `error("boom", 0)`. `instance()` returns `{ exports = self.exports, memory = function() return self._buf end }`. `liveCount()` counts `_live` keys.
10. Write `luau/tests/host.spec.luau` (`--!strict`): `check(name, cond)` printing `ok`/`FAIL` lines, `fresh()` returning a new mock plus `Host.new(mock:instance())`, one `checkLive(mock, tag)` (`liveCount() == 0`) after every host call. Cover, each with its own check name: `init once` (3 calls, `initCalls == 1`); `ascii round trip` (`echo("hello")`); `utf8 round trip` (`s = "héllo ★"`, `echo(s) == s` and `#s == 10`); `empty string` (`echo("") == ""` and `allocCalls == 0`); `empty result` (`call("empty") == ""` and `ptrCalls == 0`); `two strings in order` (`concat("ab", "cd") == "abcd"`); `number` (`addone(41) == "42"`); `zero args` (`ping() == "pong"`); `status 1` (`pcall(host.call, host, "refuse", "x")` gives exactly `"refuse refused: nope: bad deck"`, then `echo` still works); `panic trap` (after `echo("prev")`, `pcall` on `panic` gives exactly `"panic trapped: panicked at 'boom', src/lib.rs:1:1"`, then `echo` gives exactly `"echo refused: instance is dead; open a fresh one"` with `bindingCalls.echo` unchanged); `silent trap` (after `echo("prev")`, exactly `"silent trapped: no text"`); `grow between` / `grow in alloc` / `grow in binding` (direct `mock:grow()`, `growOnAlloc = true`, `growOnCall = true`, each then `echo` round-trips); `splitState nested` (`{"state":{"a":{"b":1},"s":"x\"y"},"events":[]}` cuts exactly `{"a":{"b":1},"s":"x\"y"}`; plus `{"events":[],"state":{"x":[1,{"y":"z"}]}}` cuts `{"x":[1,{"y":"z"}]}`); `bad free raises` (`jackioh_free(999, 1)` and a wrong-length free both raise); `unknown binding` (exactly `"nope refused: unknown binding"`, host not dead after).
11. Run, from the repo root: `lune run luau/tests/host.spec.luau`; then `stylua luau` once to normalize and `stylua --check luau`; then `selene luau`. Fix code, not configs, until all three are clean.
12. Breakage trials, one at a time with restore after each: free before copy-out; cache `memory()` in a local across `call`; skip the `init()` call; return the answer on status 1 instead of raising; don't set `_dead` on trap; drop the `PANIC_PREFIX` check (silent trap then reports `"prev"`); cut state with a plain string find; read `result_ptr` when `len == 0`; alloc on empty strings; an unused local (selene must flag it). Record each trial and its red output for the pull request text.

## Tests

- `luau/tests/host.spec.luau`, run as `lune run luau/tests/host.spec.luau` from the repo root. Named checks: `init once`, `ascii round trip`, `utf8 round trip`, `empty string`, `empty result`, `two strings in order`, `number`, `zero args`, `no live allocations` (the `checkLive` after every call), `status 1`, `panic trap`, `silent trap`, `dead refuses fresh instance` (the post-trap echo assertion inside `panic trap`), `grow between calls`, `grow inside alloc`, `grow inside binding`, `splitState nested braces`, `splitState state second`, `bad free raises`, `unknown binding`. The mock is the oracle: `luau/tests/mock.luau` (bump allocator from offset 1, live-set, grow flags, call counters). No framework: `check` + `process.exit(1)`.
- Style/lint gates on the same tree: `stylua --check luau` and `selene luau`, both from the repo root, both clean.

## Done when

- [ ] `lune run luau/tests/host.spec.luau` passes from a clean checkout.
- [ ] `stylua --check luau` and `selene luau` are clean.
- [ ] Every behavior above has a check that goes red when its code is broken; the pull request text lists each breakage tried (step 12) and what failed.
- [ ] No file outside `luau/` changed; the harness's `rustfmt`, `catalog`, `patches` and `spec check` gates still pass.
- [ ] `luau/README.md` states the layout, tools, install and the three commands.

## Risks

- The module caches states by exact text: `splitState` returns a substring of the answer, never a re-encoded value, so brace counting must be string- and escape-aware (an encoder that writes `{}` as `[]` is the failure the task names). The top-level member walk also ignores `"state"` text nested inside earlier string values.
- `memory.grow` can replace the buffer at any point: every `buffer.writestring`/`buffer.readstring` uses a fresh `memory()` call, including after the binding returns and after `growOnAlloc` fires inside `jackioh_alloc`. The three grow checks pin all three spots.
- The result buffer is the module's: the host never frees it, reads it before freeing argument buffers, and never touches the pointer when the length is 0 (pinned by `allocCalls`/`ptrCalls` counters).
- Freeing argument buffers on the trap path is a choice for a uniform zero-live rule against the mock; the translator's adapter (later issue) owns real post-trap behavior.
- `rokit.toml` uses Rokit's documented `[tools]` id format matching the task's pins; the builder confirms with `rokit install`. No CI job covers `luau/` yet (a person adds it), so the three local commands are the gate.

## Open questions

None. The task settles the API, messages, configs and coverage; the only open item belongs to a later issue (the translator's `instance` adapter).
````
